agent 1: it is not sponsored or supported by any governmental agencies and it helps children abroad and within the US. You would be shocked at how many children live in poverty here in the United States.
agent 2: I have an idea. Whats a more specific idea of what you do? How do you help? Whats their overall goal?

agent 1: Well, a very specific goal right is to help the children that are separated from their parents due to our current immigration problem. Can you imagine someone taking your small child away from you and not knowing where they are going, who is going to be caring for them, or if you will ever be able to see them again? As a mother, that thought is horrifying.
agent 2: It is horrifying, I could not even imagine. What do you need me to do?
